web_ui.title: Desktop task report
web_ui.description: Review the observed answer, content-free action audit and any outcome that needs checking.

init_config_review.title: Set up computer use on this Mac

fields.label: Instructions
fields.description: Describe the task, or tell me in Chat when you start. For example: send an email using Gmail.

fields.label: Output folder
fields.description: Save the result and action audit here.

fields.label: Saved instructions
fields.description: Manage preferences and working rules in Chat > Memory. Applies to future runs.

starter_questions: How do I grant permissions to mn computer use?
Can you send an email using Gmail?
What do you remember from previous tasks?

setup_guide.introduction: Give me one task on this Mac. For a small first try, ask me to read the title of the active window. I’ll check the screen and tell you what I observed.

real.introduction: Use this Mac with an unlocked desktop. Grant mn computer use Accessibility and Screen Recording when prompted, then give a task.

run_guidance.on_start: I’ll use the visible screen to check the task you gave me. If I need an app opened or a sign-in, I’ll ask in Chat.
run_guidance.output_ready: Open answer.md in the output folder to compare the requested task with the observed result.
run_guidance.web_ui_ready: Open the desktop task report and check the recorded actions against the observed answer.
